originalTitle: Wall Street stages major comeback during Thanksgiving-shortened trading week
summary: Wall Street staged a strong comeback as the S&P 500 posted its largest weekly gain in more than a year, with investors returning to battered AI stocks.
content:
Experts say AI stocks aren’t out of the woods yet as Huang’s hearings near

Pacer ETFS President Sean O'Hara and Infrastructure Capital Advisors CEO and CIO Jay Hatfield join 'Claman's Power Players' to discuss market impact after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's return.

Wall Street staged a strong comeback this week, with all three major U.S. stock indexes posting gains of more than 5% during the Thanksgiving-shortened trading week and the S&P 500 recording its largest weekly gain in more than a year.

The rebound came on the heels of last week's historic sell-off, when mounting concerns surrounding the artificial intelligence (AI) boom sent stocks tumbling.

The S&P 500 gained 5.6% for the week, marking its strongest weekly performance since April 2025, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average climbed 5.46% and the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite surged 6.68%.

All three major U.S. indexes finished higher Friday as investors returned from the Thanksgiving holiday.

MAMDANI TARGETS AMAZON ON BLACK FRIDAY AS 150K CUSTOMERS PUSH BACK AGAINST DELIVERY CRACKDOWN

Wall Street staged a strong comeback during the Thanksgiving-shortened trading week, with all three major U.S. stock indexes gaining more than 5%. (Michael Nagle/Bloomberg via Getty Images)

The Dow rose nearly 592 points, or 1.18%, while the S&P 500 gained 1.6% and the Nasdaq jumped 2.31%.

Much of the rebound was driven by investors returning to battered AI stocks, many of which suffered steep losses during the previous week's sell-off.

Chipmakers Micron and Marvell gained 7.6% and 7.3%, respectively, while Nvidia shares finished Friday's session 0.8% higher.

Other major technology companies , including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta and Oracle, also posted gains, while Tesla shares surged 5%.

BLACK FRIDAY SHOPPERS BRAVE EARLY LINES, PACKED AISLES TO SCORE IN-STORE DEALS

U.S. stocks rallied this week following a historic sell-off that pushed the Dow and S&P 500 into correction territory. (Yuki Iwamura/AFP via Getty Images)

"The market is so oversold that a bounce was inevitable," Jamie Cox, managing partner at Harris Financial Group, told Reuters.

Just one week earlier, Wall Street suffered one of its worst trading sessions in years, when a massive sell-off in AI companies wiped out the Nasdaq's gains for the year and pushed the Dow and S&P 500 into correction territory.

During that session, the Dow plunged nearly 950 points, the S&P 500 dropped 3.7% and the Nasdaq tumbled 5.28%, marking its second-largest single-day point decline on record.

Last week's losses also marked the Nasdaq's worst weekly percentage decline since March 2020.

Despite this week's strong gains, markets experienced considerable volatility , in part because of uncertainty surrounding the technology sector.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's reinstatement contributed to volatility in AI-related stocks during the Thanksgiving-shortened trading week, according to Reuters. (Sean Rayford/Getty Images)

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's reinstatement and newly public AI developer Anthropic's brief fall below its initial public offering price added to volatility in AI-related stocks, according to Reuters.

Reuters contributed to this report.
chineseTitle: 华尔街在感恩节缩短的交易周期间大幅卷土重来
chineseSummary: 华尔街强势反弹，标准普尔 500 指数创下一年多来最大单周涨幅，投资者重返遭受重创的人工智能股票。
chineseContent:
专家表示，随着黄仁勋的听证会临近，人工智能股票尚未走出困境

Pacer ETFS 总裁 Sean O'Hara 和基础设施资本顾问公司首席执行官兼首席信息官 Jay Hatfield 加入“Claman's Power Players”，讨论 Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋回归后的市场影响。

华尔街本周强势反弹，美国三大股指在感恩节缩短的交易周内涨幅均超过 5%，标普 500 指数录得一年多来最大单周涨幅。

此次反弹是在上周历史性抛售之后出现的，当时围绕人工智能（AI）繁荣的担忧加剧导致股市暴跌。

标准普尔 500 指数本周上涨 5.6%，创下 2025 年 4 月以来最强劲单周表现，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨 5.46%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克综合指数上涨 6.68%。

随着投资者从感恩节假期归来，美国三大股指周五均收高。

由于 15 万客户抵制送货限制，MAMDANI 在黑色星期五瞄准亚马逊

华尔街在感恩节缩短的交易周内强势反弹，美国三大股指涨幅均超过5%。 （迈克尔·内格尔/彭博社，盖蒂图片社）

道琼斯指数上涨近592点，涨幅1.18%，标准普尔500指数上涨1.6%，纳斯达克指数上涨2.31%。

反弹很大程度上是由投资者重返遭受重创的人工智能股票推动的，其中许多股票在前一周的抛售中遭受了大幅损失。

芯片制造商美光科技 (Micron) 和 Marvell 分别上涨 7.6% 和 7.3%，而英伟达 (Nvidia) 股价周五收盘上涨 0.8%。

包括亚马逊、微软、Meta 和甲骨文在内的其他主要科技公司也纷纷上涨，特斯拉股价飙升 5%。

黑色星期五购物者勇敢地早起排队，过道挤满人，以获得店内优惠

在历史性抛售推动道琼斯指数和标准普尔 500 指数进入回调区域后，美国股市本周上涨。 （岩村由纪/法新社盖蒂图片社）

哈里斯金融集团 (Harris Financial Group) 管理合伙人杰米·考克斯 (Jamie Cox) 告诉路透社，“市场已经超卖，反弹是不可避免的。”

就在一周前，华尔街遭遇了多年来最糟糕的交易日之一，人工智能公司的大规模抛售抹去了纳斯达克指数今年的涨幅，并将道琼斯指数和标准普尔 500 指数推入调整区间。

当日，道指暴跌近 950 点，标普 500 指数下跌 3.7%，纳斯达克指数下跌 5.28%，创下有记录以来第二大单日跌幅。

纳斯达克指数上周的跌幅也创下了自 2020 年 3 月以来最严重的单周百分比跌幅。

尽管本周股市强劲上涨，但市场仍经历了相当大的波动，部分原因是科技行业的不确定性。

据路透社报道，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋的复职导致感恩节缩短的交易周期间人工智能相关股票的波动。 （肖恩·雷福德/盖蒂图片社）

据路透社报道，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋的复职以及新上市的人工智能开发商 Anthropic 股价短暂跌破首次公开募股价格，加剧了人工智能相关股票的波动。

路透社对此报告作出了贡献。
